description: The plot illustrates how AUC (in percent) varies with the hyperparameter **N** for five different series. The x-axis is labeled **N**, shown on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20, and the plotted points appear at N = 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled **AUC (%)**, on a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100 with regularly spaced tick labels every 5 units. A blue solid line with open circle markers starts near 94% at N=1, rises to about 98–99% at N=5 and remains about the same at N=10, then decreases to roughly 96–97% at N=15 and about 94–95% at N=20. A red solid line with open square markers begins around 87% at N=1, increases to about 92% at N=5, peaks around 98–99% at N=10, then declines to about 93% at N=15 and about 91% at N=20. An orange solid line with open diamond markers starts near 84% at N=1, increases to about 93% at N=5, continues upward to about 94–95% at N=10 and about 95% at N=15, and ends slightly lower near 94–95% at N=20. A green solid line with star markers begins around 86–87% at N=1, rises to about 91% at N=5 and about 92–93% at N=10, reaches about 94–95% at N=15, and then decreases to roughly 92–93% at N=20. A purple solid line with inverted triangle markers starts near 79% at N=1, stays around 79% at N=5, jumps to about 96–97% at N=10, then drops to about 86% at N=15 and about 82–83% at N=20.
